dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: I heard that some of the stories in these books talk about completely made-up beings, but with incredibly life-like illustrations...

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Do you think the author drew them purely from their imagination? I'd love the chance to learn from them if so.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: If I had that kind of skill, the Field Guide to Demons and Beasts wouldn't be in the sorry state it is now...
